concern_results.conclusion: No bypass reproduced: the checkpoint names the extraction owner only when the marker exists at a parent root of a skills/, hooks/ or scripts/ component (every-component probe, empty-root guarded, plugin-cache and .codex exclusions present and test-pinned both directions), relative paths resolve against payload cwd, attempt-spending and deny/ask/advisory logic are untouched so one replan per context holds, and the stop backstop's loop is set -u-safe on bash 3.2 (empty-candidate guard, empty-component skip, quoted expansions, heredoc terminator fixed at parse time) with no scope widening beyond the marker check; only register/plan claim mismatches found, reported below

Containment holds: the change adds read-only is_file/-f stat probes bounded by path component count (and the existing 40-candidate cap in the backstop), introduces no new deny path, write, or execution surface, hostile path text cannot inject globs or heredoc terminators, and the one new shared-gate input class (markdown on the shared surface) is acceptance-sanctioned with precision tests pinning the false-positive direction
